SIMON FRASER UNIVERSITY
POSITION DESCRIPTION
Administrative and Professional Staff Positions

A. IDENTIFICATION
POSITION TITLE: Research Grants Coordinator
DEPARTMENT: Office of Research Services
POSITION NO.: 00456789
NAME OF EMPLOYEE: [name redacted]
DATE: 15 March 2005

B. POSITION SUMMARY
The Research Grants Coordinator processes research grant applications to ensure
that agency policies and guidelines have been met, and coordinates the flow of
information between researchers and funding agencies.

C. DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES
- Processes research grant applications by confirming revisions, checking
  budgets, and drawing attention to compliance issues.
- Coordinates communication between principal investigators and external
  funding agencies.
- Maintains accurate records of grant activity and prepares periodic reports.

D. DECISION MAKING
The Coordinator is responsible for making decisions regarding:
- The completeness and compliance of submitted grant applications.
- The prioritization of competing application deadlines.

E. PROBLEM SOLVING
Responsible for solving problems related to:
- Discrepancies between application budgets and agency guidelines.
- Conflicting submission deadlines during peak funding periods.

F. RELATIONSHIPS
Supervision Received: Works under the general direction of the Manager,
Research Services.
Internal Connections: Liaises with faculty researchers and departmental finance
staff.
External Connections: Corresponds with federal and provincial granting agencies.

G. QUALIFICATIONS
Bachelor's degree in a relevant discipline and three years of related
administrative experience, or an equivalent combination of education, training
and experience.
- Working knowledge of research grant administration and Tri-Agency guidelines.
- Intermediate skills in spreadsheet and database applications.
- Ability to interpret and apply complex policies and guidelines.
